At some point last fall someone hanging out in the porch-garden and chowing something with fresh tomato (pretty common fare in these parts) must have dropped a seed into one of the indoor plants that lives in a really big pot.

I generally let things sprout in those big pots, just to see what they are. This guy appeared and got no direct sunlight for all of about two weeks before I brought the plants inside for the season. I had no idea if it was a weed or whatever else, but he sent a scrawny vine with small crumpled leaves across the dirt floor of the pot in search of sunlight for six months.

As I began to prep the big’uns for springtime this year, I finally chipped a piece of leaf off to see if it smelled like anything, cause I had no clue just looking at it. There was no doubt, it’s a tomato.
